notes: DECLARED ONLY: no router adapter serves this wire today (adapters is empty). It names the documented generateContent / streamGenerateContent family a Google-compatible vendor endpoint speaks, WITHOUT the v1internal envelope Antigravity wraps around the same parts (google-generative-sse carries {response: {...}}; this wire carries the response object directly, which is why the two are separate ids in WIRE_PROTOCOLS). None of the mapping is measured through this repository: the canonical paths are the public docs' field names, and the capabilities are protocol-family defaults. In particular structuredOutput (generationConfig.responseMimeType + responseSchema) and cache (cachedContentTokenCount reporting, not a cache the router controls) are NOT verified by any adapter here, and no fixture pins them; a future adapter must add one and this revision must move if the canonical fields change. Reasoning again depends on thinkingConfig.includeThoughts and appears as parts carrying thought: true; effort selection is vendor-specific and unmeasured.
